snippet.title: Cthulhu's Reach: Devil Reef - Steam Deck Verified
snippet.description:
Greetings, seekers of abyssal mastery!

Through vials of ichor and blood incantations, we have navigated strands of arcane knowledge throughout time and space to emerge reborn as Steam Deck Verified!

Do check us out on deck, it plays great!

You may have noticed we've posted our roadmap through early access to grant you foreknowledge of Things That Shall Be.

We'll begin with new customizations options, weapons, and incantations to face ever-more-terrifying enemies, followed by a map editor that will let you put into practice the arcane knowledge that YOU have gathered on your journey, dear traveller.

We will slither to the finish with a new Act III and all the glories that entails, including our final boss....

...or is it?

Check out Cthulhu's Reach: Devil Reef:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2412200/Cthulhus_Reach_Devil_Reef/

Visit us at:
https://firstbreaklabs.com/ 

Follow us on our socials!
